E-TRANSITION-PLAN: We have committed to net zero by 2045 and set a 2030 target to reduce Scope 1 and 2 emissions by 42% against a 2021 baseline. The target is not yet validated by SBTi. A transition plan covering electrification of process heat and a renewable power purchase agreement was approved by the board in 2024. Scope 3 emissions are being screened but no target is set yet.
S-HUMAN-RIGHTS: Our human rights policy references the UN Guiding Principles. In 2024 we completed a risk assessment of tier-1 suppliers in high-risk countries and audited 40 sites. Workers can raise concerns through a hotline operated by a third party. Tier-2 suppliers are not yet covered.
G-ETHICS: We have an anti-corruption policy and code of conduct; 92% of employees completed online anti-corruption training in 2024. A whistleblowing channel allows anonymous reports and cases are reviewed quarterly by the audit committee. High-risk distributors undergo due diligence before onboarding.
